USGS NAS records are provisional and vary in accuracy, scale, completeness, population status, and temporal currency. The assertion aggregates qualifying occurrence rows for one county-species pair and preserves every raw row in the immutable archive. Archive silence never supports absence or non-detection. Coordinates were retained as lineage but were not used to determine a county equivalent.

AFPE v1.0 is a historical county detection compilation and is stale for current-source readiness. A value of 1 supports recorded-present only, not current abundance or complete distribution. A value of 0 is never verified absence or survey non-detection. The published files provide common names and DCA columns, so taxon publication is limited to the 13 manually reviewed mappings.
